## Purpose
What is wrong with a process document and how to fix it. The same dialog appears wherever a document is uploaded.

## Responsibilities
- `ValidationReportDialog`, `ReportView` and `IssueRow` (the line, the problem and the fix).
- It offers four ways out: fix with AI, re-upload a corrected file, download the template, or download the report.

## Key elements
`ValidationReportDialog`, `ReportView`, `IssueRow`.
